relations: Dante 与 Ophelia 本章互认 falling in love；他称她 Angel。
River 与 Jazz 将领队护盾，Ophelia 与 Dante 殿后拆魔法开电梯；Kat、Merrily、Grayson 守顶楼，Callum 统一指挥。
Darius 是夏之 fae 王，mate 是刺客，两人负责处理 Reaper。
春之 fae 女王与 soulmate 迟到两分钟赶到；多数 fae 王室凭发光 soulmate bond 可辨。

facts.fact: 接下来两周两人形影不离打磨监狱计划，她还常把想法发给 River 交流。
facts.anchor: I spent the next two weeks working out the details of exactly what we'd need to do with the prison.

facts.fact: 他被人挑战王座时她在场观战（毫无悬念）；慈善晚会在第八个人撞她、Dante 差点拧断对方脑袋后提前离场。
facts.anchor: Went to a charity gala together (and left early, after the eighth person bumped into me and Dante nearly ripped their head off).

facts.fact: 几周后她与 River 回监狱，花几天调好上层；完工后 Dante 把瘫软的她抱回家。
facts.anchor: It took us a few days to get the upper floors running the way we needed them to.

facts.fact: Dante 明确要求她待在他和 fae 身后直到 Reaper 死；两人将下底层拆解她几乎全部旧魔法。
facts.anchor: Dante had made it clear that I would be staying behind him and the fae until Reaper was dead

facts.fact: 他边做拿铁边安抚：你不会有事；若有事发生在我身上你会好好的。两人互认这几周是一生最幸福。
facts.anchor: Nothing is going to happen to you. If something happens to me, you’ll be fine

facts.fact: 台面亲热时他坦白 I'm falling in love with you, Angel，她回应自己也爱上了他。
facts.anchor: I’m falling in love with you, Angel,” Dante confessed against my lips, as he thrust into me slowly

facts.fact: Callum 部署：囚犯移往顶楼，River 与 Jasmine 领队护盾，Ophelia 与 Dante 殿后。
facts.anchor: We're moving all of the prisoners to the top floor of the prison. River and Jasmine will be leading, and shielding all of us.

facts.fact: Dante 指出人数太多得两趟，且不确定她的魔力够不够连开两次；她的十分钟被他改成三十。
facts.anchor: We'll have to take two trips. And I don't know if Ophelia has the power reserves to work the elevator twice in a row
